prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a rear-end collision. The patient had 17 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1323; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with right shoulder pain and restricted range of motion. The reported mechanism and force of impact are consistent with the injury described. Over the course of 17 visits, care followed a typical progression, beginning with conservative management including physical therapy, activity modification, and targeted home exercises, and tapering in frequency as symptoms improved. Examination findings were mixed: several provocative maneuvers and range-of-motion measurements support a soft tissue injury to the shoulder, while other tests, including neurovascular assessment and strength testing, returned normal results. No prior injury or treatment involving this body region is known. Billing records reflect single, appropriately spaced charges for each service with no duplicated entries. Patient was discharged from active care with a plan for self-directed exercise and follow-up as needed.
